_comment: VARIETYSTRUCTUREPLAN Band 2 (D4/§5) — layers a token Create scrap (Andesite Alloy, the mod's earliest crafting mat) onto the Create derelicts' chest. Inert without Create: AddDropModifier resolves the id via Lookup.hasItem and adds nothing when absent, so this ships safely in the base mod. Gate-safe: a common early mat, never bulk brass / precision mechanisms / a working contraption.
